testcase.name: Scenario: Retain a custom command in its expanded area across a ribbon tab switch: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:898:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain a custom command in its expanded area across a ribbon tab switch ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full Tools ribbon is visible ✔ And the Part Tools custom panel target is initially empty ✔ And 2D Sketches has been added to the Part Tools custom panel ✔ And 2D Sketches has been moved into the User Commands expanded area ✔ When the user opens the User Commands expanded area ✔ Then the 2D Sketches icon is visible in that area ✔ When the user selects the 3D Model ribbon tab ✔ Then the Tools expanded area is no longer visible ✔ When the user selects the Tools ribbon tab again ✔ Then the User Commands panel is collapsed and offers an expansion control ✔ And the 2D Sketches icon is absent from its main area ✔ When the user opens the User Commands expanded area ✔ Then the 2D Sketches icon is visible in that area
